snippet:
The three-person team at Seattle-based SK Studios has announced Ignite the Depths, an atmospheric dark-fantasy dungeon crawler where players descend through three handcrafted dimensions, combining unique class abilities to overcome raid-inspired bosses and environmental puzzles in solo or four-player co-op. [...] Everything in Ignite the Depths is designed around deep co-op synergy, rewarding creative teamwork and ability combinations to overcome the Abyss's many dangers. Annihilating barrels and uncovering hidden treasure will reward you with resources that can be spent at Pickle and Po's shop to craft powerful builds and customize each class. [...] Ignite the Depths features four distinct classes. Players can choose to bombard enemies with magic, protect allies through timed parries, or master other combat styles built around cooperative play. 

Ignite the Depths features a dreamy retro-inspired art style that blends classic visuals with modern rendering techniques to create a distinctive aesthetic.

title: Ignite the Depths Revealed, Bringing Raid-Inspired Co-Op Dungeon Crawling to PC - COGconnected
snippet:
Seattle-based indie developer SK Studios has officially announced Ignite the Depths, a new atmospheric dark-fantasy dungeon crawler that puts teamwork at the center of the experience. Developed by a three-person team, the game lets players descend through three handcrafted dimensions filled with dangerous enemies, environmental puzzles, and raid-inspired boss fights. It can be played solo or with up to four players in co-op. [...] Visually, Ignite the Depths embraces a dreamy retro-inspired art style that blends classic aesthetics with modern rendering techniques. Each of the three dimensions concludes with a unique boss battle featuring custom mechanics, environmental challenges, and large-scale encounters that demand both teamwork and individual skill. [...] “We wanted to recreate the feeling of tackling MMO-style dungeons with a close group of friends without the long grind that usually entails. We hope players will still get the satisfaction of crafting and upgrading their class in preparation for these set pieces,” said Marcus Klammt, developer at SK Studios.

Ignite the Depths launches in Q3 2026, with playtests planned ahead of release. If you enjoy challenging co-op adventures, this is one to keep an eye on.
